part.text:
FLAG{d447d54e509248b084deb44076b5f49e}

The `/ping` endpoint only prints captured regex groups from `"(.*?) packets transmitted, (.*?) received, (.*?)% packet loss"`. I suppressed ping (`notahost`) and injected `echo $(cat /FLAG.txt) packets transmitted...` so the flag landed inside the parsed group.
